task_name: Build-id reload hook for open tabs

concerns_addressed: Middleware order: registerHealthRoutes mounted before setCsrfToken/csrfProtection; unauthenticated, CSRF-free, no cookie; /health only skips CSRF cookie and uploads static; rate limiter (auth only) unaffected.
isShuttingDown read live via closure per request; shutdown 503 works on both paths.
Both /health and /api/health serve old payload + buildId.

Hook: reload only on res.ok + non-empty differing string buildId; reloading flag (once per page load); inFlight guard; no reload on non-2xx/503/fetch or JSON failure; first-fail capture without reload; cleanup on unmount; cache no-store; no UI.
Hook mounted at top of App() before early returns; 48 lines, comment-free, no new dependency.
Dockerfile ARG/ENV BUILD_ID in runner stage; contract test slices from last FROM.
Test hygiene: env, fetch stub and window.location restored; source contract asserts '/api/health' and buildId.
Flaky server run not attributable to this diff.

strengths: Health logic in small testable lib/health.ts; correct kernel placement and import styles.
index.ts 192 lines, App.tsx 204; no long functions or duplication.
HEALTH_PATH contract pinned between server and hook.
Behavioral tests with fake timers; real Express routes under RUN_INTEGRATION.

issues.description: Route tests gated behind RUN_INTEGRATION; middleware order (before setCsrfToken) in index.ts not covered by a test.
No debounce between visibility events and interval tick; bounded by inFlight guard; negligible.
